### Jesus Has Given You His Promise Ring…
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-september-14-2019.html
Passage: Revelation 19:7
Points:
- Salvation brings believers into an espousal to Jesus Christ, meaning they already belong to Him prior to the final wedding.
- Rather than a temporary physical ring, Christ gives believers the Holy Spirit as the guarantee of their future inheritance.
- Jesus gave Himself up to purify and sanctify His church so that she may be presented without spot or wrinkle.
- Believers should actively prepare their hearts and lives in joyful devotion for the coming marriage of the Lamb.

### The Marriage Supper of the Lamb
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-marriage-supper-of-the-lamb
Passage: Revelation 19:6-10
Points:
- Heavenly worship celebrates the sovereign reign of God and the ultimate overthrow of every power opposing Christ.
- The marriage supper of the Lamb fulfills the prophetic promise of an age of celebratory feasting and the consummation of God's kingdom.
- The church is portrayed as a pure bride adorned in fine linen, standing in direct contrast to worldly corruption.
- The bride's righteous garments and good deeds are not self-earned, but are gifts granted by Christ through grace.
- Though the church is currently flawed, believers can trust that Christ is actively sanctifying His bride until the final celebration.
